$comment: Harborline canonical capability→authority registry for the workflow admission gate and the broker-PEP. Content provenance: Shipyard packages/carrier-sdk/src/command-authority.json at blob 74d32d5a7060aa39aa277f8bab606788404f2d8f (the same source hlp.contracts.workflow pins as its authorityRegistry provenance), re-homed as a Harborline-owned file so the engine's canonical registry has a Harborline source of truth. The TypeScript admission mirror consumes the same rows through the host-supplied authority resolver, so a CP/AP disagreement across runtimes remains impossible by construction. An unknown capability always resolves CP (fail-closed) regardless of this file's contents.
